9.d: Paremal gootistiilis ehituse orvas asuva pühakuju ees põlvitav paljasjalgne rauk, toetumas kapile; tema taga vasakul püsti seismas noor paljasjalgne tütarlaps, käed ristis. Vasakul äärel kivist ja puust riste ja hauakive. Taga keskel suur lehtpuu ja vasakul põõsaid.
9.de: On the right, a barefoot old man kneels before a sacred figure in a Gothic-style building's niche, leaning on a cupboard; behind him on the left a young barefoot girl stands upright, arms crossed. On the left edge stone and wooden crosses and gravestones. In the back centre a large deciduous tree and bushes on the left.

15.de: In a glass vase with a foot bulging in the middle, various and multi-coloured garden flowers (dahlias predominate). On the table single leaves and blossoms.

5646.d: Põskhabeme ja vurrudega mehe portree. Sõjaväelase mundris epolettide ja hulga ordenitega. Üle parema õla hall sinel.
5646.de: Portrait of a man with side whiskers and a moustache. In a military uniform with epaulettes and numerous orders. A grey greatcoat over his right shoulder.

5648.d: Noore, ruugejuukselise ja pruunisilmse mehe portree poolprofiilis paremale. Käharad juuksed kõrvu pooleldi vabaks jätvas soengus. Pikad teravaotsalised vurrud ja väikene kikkhabe. Tumedat värvitooni rõivastus laia, valge, tärgeldatud krookkaelusega.
5648.de: Portrait of a young, brown-haired and brown-eyed man in half-profile to the right. Curly hair in a style leaving the ears half exposed. Long, pointed moustache and a small goatee. Dark-toned attire with a wide, white, starched ruff collar.

5936.d: Vaade ülalt kõrgelt kaldalt merele. Ees vasakul üksiku kuuse juures selgvaates mees. Paremal kuuskede grupp. Taamal meri.
5936.de: View from a high shore down onto the sea. In front on the left, by a solitary spruce, a man seen clearly. On the right a group of spruces. In the distance, the sea.

5940.d: Mehe rinnapilt, poolprofiilis paremale. Sinine kuub ja aumärk-rist kaelas.
5940.de: Bust portrait of a man, in half-profile to the right. Blue coat and a cross-shaped medal on his neck.

5943.dm: lehe laius: 32.7 cm; lehe kõrgus: 16.0 cm
5943.d: Üle lagendiku vaade taga kõrgendiku jalal olevale linnale ja selle tipul olevatele lossivaremetele. Kolmveerandiku tööst moodustab pilvine taevas.
5943.de: A view across a clearing to a town in the background on the foot of a rise and, on its summit, castle ruins. Three-quarters of the work is made up of a cloudy sky.

5945.d: Vanema mehe rinnapilt, poolprofiilis paremale. Põskhabe, seljas must kuub ja must kaelaside.
5945.de: Bust portrait of an older man, in half-profile to the right. Side-whiskers, wearing a black coat and a black cravat.

5951.d: Keskel punase linaga kaetud laua ümber perekond. Laua taga sohval istuvad isa ja ema, nende ees laual väike tüdruk ja laua kõrval seismas teine. Käsitoel, ema selja taga kolmas. Eespool lauda vasakul toolil istub üliõpilase vormis noormees. Paremal kolm poissi, neist üks koolpoisi vormikuues. Poiste selja taga seismas vana naine.
5951.de: In the middle, a family around a table covered with a red cloth. Behind the table, father and mother sit on a sofa, in front of them on the table a small girl and another standing beside the table. On the armrest, behind the mother's back, a third one. In front of the table on the left, a young man in a student's uniform sits on a chair. On the right three boys, one of them in a schoolboy's uniform coat. Behind the boys' backs stands an old woman.

6074.d: Narmasõlakutega mereväeparaadkuues noormehe põlvpilt peaaegu enface. Parem käsi toetatud ankru ristpuule.
6074.de: Knee-length portrait of a young man in a naval dress uniform with fringed epaulettes, almost en face. Right hand resting on the crossbar of an anchor.

6155.d: Merelaht, mille ees väikeste põõsastega rand.
6155.de: Sea bay with a shore lined with small bushes in front.

6156.d: Esiplaanilt keskelt pildi sügavusse suunduv kõrgete puudega ääristatud tee, kus jalutab mees koeraga.
6156.de: A path lined with tall trees leading from the middle foreground into the depth of the picture, where a man is walking with a dog.

6157.d: Vaade kõrgetest mägedest piiratud järvele. Esiplaanil vasakul kaldariba puudega.
6157.de: View of a lake enclosed by high mountains. In the foreground on the left a strip of shore with trees.

6191.d: Mehe poolfiguur, pea poolprofiilis vasakule. Põskhabe, juuksed püstihoidvana. Mundris, ordenipaela ja ordenitega. Käed kehast eemal.
6191.de: Half-figure of a man, head in half-profile to the left. Side whiskers, hair standing upright. In uniform, with an order ribbon and orders. Hands held away from the body.

6383.d: Esiplaanil rahvarõivais mees ja naine. Nende vahel väike valges särgis laps. Naisel käes lehter. Tagplaanil vasakul kõrtsihoone, paremal mööda teed sõitev hobune vankriga, eemal künkal veski.
6383.de: In the foreground a man and a woman in folk costume. Between them a small child in a white shirt. The woman holds a funnel. In the background on the left an inn building, on the right a horse with a cart driving along the road, in the distance a mill on a hill.

6384.d: Madal talutare tantsivate paaridega. Paremal kaabuga torupilli mängija. Esiplaanil keskel laps ajab vitsaga põrsast taga.
6384.de: A low farmhouse with dancing couples. On the right a bagpipe player wearing a hat. In the foreground in the centre, a child chasing a piglet with a switch.

6790.d: Vanema naise poolfiguur istuvas asendis, kerge pöördega paremale, hallikassinises valge pitskraega kleidis, valges kogu nägu ümbritsevas tülltanus, õlgadel kirju rätik. Käed vaheliti süles.
6790.de: Half-figure of an older woman in a seated position, with a slight turn to the right, in a greyish-blue dress with a white lace collar, in a white tulle bonnet surrounding the whole face, a patterned shawl on the shoulders. Hands crossed in the lap.

6794.d: Põskhabemega mehe poolfiguur veerandprofiilis paremale. Silmad sinakad, nägu täidlane. Seljas tume, eest lahtine kuub ja eest kinninööbitud (5 nööpi) vest. Valge kaelus, tume kaelaside, mille üle nähtav valge krae äär.
6794.de: Half-figure of a bearded man in three-quarter profile facing right. Bluish eyes, full face. Wearing a dark coat open at the front and a waistcoat buttoned at the front (5 buttons). White collar, dark necktie, over which the white edge of the collar is visible.

6920.d: Esiplaanil oja kaldal kaks rahvariides istuvat naisfiguuri. Nende seljataga jämeda puutüve tagant vasakul piilub kaabus noormees. Paremal tagaplaanil järv paadiga kaldal ning suur kask.
6920.de: In the foreground on the bank of a stream two seated female figures in national costume. Behind them, from behind a thick tree trunk on the left, a young man in a hat peeks out. In the background on the right a lake with a boat on the shore and a large birch.

6922.d: Suure kaarvärava juures kaks eesti rahvuslikes seelikutes ja käistes naist. Parempoolne, sirbiga käes, seisasb eredas päikesevalguses, vasakpoolne istub varjus.
6922.de: By a large arched gate, two women in Estonian national skirts and sleeves. The one on the right, holding a sickle, stands in bright sunlight; the one on the left sits in shadow.

6964.d: Esiplaanil vasemal paekivi, paremal merd vaatlev selgvaates naisfiguur pikas kleidis. Keskplaanil vasakul kaljurahn, paremal veepind kividega. Veel üksik paat kahe sõitjaga. Keskplaanil keskel üksik puu. Puu taga horisondil mets. Taeva allosas paremal pilvede tagant osalt nähtav kuuketas.
6964.de: In the foreground on the left, limestone; on the right, a female figure in full view, in a long dress, looking at the sea. In the middle ground on the left, a rocky boulder, on the right a water surface with stones. Also a single boat with two passengers. In the centre of the middle ground a solitary tree. Behind the tree, forest on the horizon. In the lower part of the sky on the right, the moon disc partly visible behind clouds.

7082.d: Ees paremal tallipoiss hoidmas keskel latrite ees seisvat tumehalli hobust, taga latrites kolm hobust; vasakul ees hobuste tekke.
7082.de: In front on the right a stable boy holding a dark grey horse standing in the middle in front of the stalls, behind in the stalls three horses; in front on the left horse blankets.

7161.d: Ees jõgi millest vasakul üks haru paremale veski taha suundub. Vastaskaldal, keskel veski koos kõrvalhoonetega, vasemal sild; silla juures sõudepaat.
7161.de: In front a river, on the left one branch turns right behind the mill. On the opposite bank, in the centre a mill with outbuildings, on the left a bridge; by the bridge a rowing boat.

7162.d: Ees veekogu. Keskel veski koos rea kõrvalhoonetega. Vasemal paadisild. Sillal kaks poisikese figuuri. 2/3 tööst pilvist taevast.
7162.de: In front a body of water. In the middle a mill with a row of outbuildings. On the left a boat bridge. On the bridge two boy figures. 2/3 of the work cloudy sky.

7282.d: Istuva naise poolfiguur - en face. Peas valge, rüüžidega tanu. Käed vaheliti rüpes.
7282.de: Half-figure of a seated woman, en face. On her head a white bonnet with ruffles. Hands crossed in her lap.

7290.d: Kolme väikese tüdruku poolfiguurid grupina istumas. Parempoolsel süles pikakarvaline koer.
7290.de: Half-figures of three small girls sitting as a group. On the right one's lap a long-haired dog.

7383.dm: kõrgus: 95.0 cm (vm.); laius: 141.0 cm (arm.); kõrgus: 96.5 cm; laius: 133.5 cm (vm.)
7383.d: Esiplaanil, keskel, tantsijate grupp rahvarõivais, vasemal mehefiguurid viiuldajaga keskel, paremal laua taga istuv noorpaar - peigmees helesinises kuues, mõrsja pärjastatud. Talutuba rohelisega kaunistatud.
7383.de: In the foreground, in the centre, a group of dancers in folk costume, on the left male figures with a violinist in the middle, on the right a young couple sitting at a table - the groom in a light blue coat, the bride wreathed. The farmhouse room decorated with greenery.

7392.d: Noor naine valges siidikleidis kinkidega laua taga. Vasakus käes kollane siidirätik. Laual tort, roosid ja karp ehetega. Naise vaade suunatud kollase siidirätiku ülemise serva poole.
7392.de: A young woman in a white silk dress at a table with gifts. In her left hand a yellow silk scarf. On the table a cake, roses and a box with jewelry. The woman's gaze directed toward the upper edge of the yellow silk scarf.

7410.d: Esiplaanil kaks poissi kirsse ostmas noorelt naiselt, kelle kõrval seisab noormees, paremal sammastega hoone.
7410.de: In the foreground two boys buying cherries from a young woman, next to whom stands a young man, on the right a building with columns.

7411.d: Tumepruuni värvi hobuse figuur täisprofiilis vasakule, seotud posti külge.
7411.de: Figure of a dark brown horse in full profile to the left, tied to a post.

7682.d: Vanema mehe rindportree veerandpöördes vasakule, pilk vaatajal. Mehel hõre põskhabe, paljas otsmik, sinised silmad. Seljas kuldnööpidega sinine kuub, aumärk rinnas, kaelusest paistab valge žaboo.
7682.de: Bust portrait of an older man, three-quarter turned to the left, gaze on the viewer. The man has a sparse side-beard, a bare forehead, blue eyes. Wearing a blue coat with gilt buttons, a decoration on the chest, a white jabot visible at the collar.

8583.d: Keskealise naise rinnafiguur kerges pöördes vasakule. Seljas hall avara dekolteega kleit, peas pitstanu.
8583.de: Bust figure of a middle-aged woman in a slight turn to the left. Wearing a grey dress with a wide décolletage, a lace cap on her head.

8702.d: Vanema mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale, hallide käharate juuste ja tumeda ülikonnaga. Taustaks maastik - õlgkatusega majake ja naisefiguur puu all paremal.
8702.de: Bust of an older man in half-profile to the right, with grey curly hair and a dark suit. Background is a landscape - a small thatched-roof house and a female figure under a tree on the right.

8793.d: Interjööris istuva mehe täisfiguur poolprofiilis paremale, parem käsi toetatud rohelise kattega lauale. Uksest avaneb vaade kõrvalruumidesse. Figuuri taga seinal musta riidega kaetud tsaariportree (ilmselt Nikolai I).
8793.de: Full figure of a man seated in an interior, in half-profile to the right, right hand resting on a table with a green cover. Through a door a view opens into adjoining rooms. Behind the figure on the wall a portrait of the tsar (apparently Nicholas I) covered with black cloth.

9248.d: Eest taha suunudval kitsal rohtunud kaljuplatool sööv ja mäletsev kari. Paremal näha allapoole laskuval kaldal kasvavate puude latvu. Vasakul künkaline kaljukallas.
9248.de: On a narrow grassy rocky plateau receding from front to back, a herd grazing and ruminating. On the right the treetops of trees growing on a bank descending downward are visible. On the left a hilly rocky bank.

9611.d: Järv. Paremal kallas (Sõsarsaare serv) lehestikuga ja haralise vana pajuga, mille üks haru ulatub horisontaalsuunas veepinna kohale. Vasakult paistab Kloostrisaar.
9611.de: A lake. On the right, a shore (the edge of Sõsarsaar) with foliage and a branching old willow, one branch of which extends horizontally above the water surface. Kloostrisaar can be seen on the left.

10235.d: Haige põetamise olmestseen ajaloolises interjööris. Kompositsiooni keskel kolm naisfiguuri: üks vanem daam lamab voodis, teine istub toolil näoga haige poole ning kolmas seisab profiilis voodi kõrval, käes valge anum.
10235.de: A genre scene of nursing a patient in a historical interior. In the centre of the composition three female figures: one older lady lies in bed, another sits on a chair facing the patient, and a third stands in profile beside the bed, holding a white vessel.

10319.dm: kõrgus: 85.0 cm (lm.); laius: 63.5 cm (arm.); kõrgus: 81.0 cm; laius: 69.0 cm (lm.)
10319.d: Põskhabemes tahakammitud juustega, madala püstkraega kuues keskealise mehe poolfiguur pöördega paremale, tagaplaanil park ja paremal sammastega ja skulptuuridega maamõisa taoline hoone, tume sinakashall taevajoon.
10319.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged man with side-whiskers and combed-back hair, wearing a garment with a low standing collar, turned to the right, in the background a park and on the right a manor-house-like building with columns and sculptures, dark bluish-grey skyline.
